purpose: Design spec defining the state models and permitted transitions for ToC publication, ToC build/rebuild runs, and DLID embedding runs, as normative transition tables.
summary: Separation of ToC publication state from build progress; rebuild-needed and missing-reference are judgments, not states
Stateless operations: search, DLID resolution, and checks never change management state
Confirmed ToC transitions P-01 to P-03 (unbuilt, published, failure keeps prior state)
Build run transitions B-01 to B-09 from started through scope, IDs, changes, data, refs, candidate, finished, failed
Failure handling: no candidate published, prior confirmed ToC kept, no automatic retry, document info not rolled back
Reference check result categories and freshness (match, path mismatch, absent in directory)
DLID embedding run transitions E-01 to E-07 including duplicate original confirmation and write-only-DLID rule
Mermaid state diagrams visualizing the tables; script rejects transitions not in the tables
State transition testing policy delegated to the verification design
tasks: Implementing ToC build or rebuild scripts
Implementing the embed-dlid DLID embedding operation
Reviewing failure and retry behavior of builds
Deciding whether an operation may change management state
Designing error reports for failed build stages
Checking consistency between requirements and design transitions
title: DES-004 状態モデルと許可遷移
